notes.title: Update 42 (v1.3.0.5)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Here's an update with some bug fixes and other changes. To be more specific about the main changes - we removed "No weapons in the shop" passive ability for Enigma character. With this ability removed, in general nothing changed for Enigma - even if a weapon is purchased in the shop it will be changed to a random weapon after leaving a shop. However, it enables some additional pros like being able to make use of Tag and Gift Bag items and playing in co-op another player now will be able to purchase a weapon.

More detailed patch notes:

[b]Changes[/b][list]
[*] Removed "No weapons in the shop" passive ability for Enigma character.
[*] Playing on EASY difficulty Ravel enemy will charge towards player slower compared to NORMAL difficulty.
[*] Playing Goosebumps challenge in co-op Pocket Ghosts for that challenge will move slower.
[*] Removed Black Matter, Surprise and Paranoia artifacts from Collector challenge.
[*] Defeated bosses in Collector challenge will drop an item instead of artifact.
[*] If Enigma character will carry artifacts with 3 or more risk value will increase a chance to get better weapons.
[*] Edited "Odd Egg" artifact name in Russian translation.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where in some occasions players could lose HP after entering the door.
[*] Fixed a bug where in rare occasions Plasma Gun projectiles never disappeared if bounced in small space. 
[/list]

We also received some reports about the bugs that are very rare and occur only in a very specific situations. Due to this it's very difficult to reproduce them and find the exact cause, so we added some additional safety checks that potentially could prevent them from happening:
[list]
[*] A bug where occasionally in the late loops (over loop 20) the game froze on loading level state.
[*] A bug where if dropped loot (coins, hearts, keys) ended up on destroyed bushes it instantly teleported to the initial spawn position.
[/list]

Best regards,
Tomas & Eduardas

notes.title: v1.2 Content Update Is Out Now
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're super excited today - Blazing Beaks [b]1 YEAR game release anniversary[/b] content update is here! :) As we mentioned earlier, it's not as big as a previous one, nevertheless, new cool stuff is waiting for you.
Time really flies fast and one year later we have a big and very supportive community who still make suggestions, give advices for new players, share their strategies and etc. So we want to say a big thank you for your help and support!

Some of our community suggestions and concept ideas made it to this update. So get ready to blast enemies with 10 new weapons. We also added 5 new active abilities which give more ways to play the game using different strategies. We added one more new vexing ːsteamsaltyːːsteamsaltyːːsteamsaltyː artifact to already vast amount of them :) 

We also updated Blazing Beaks Character Editor and added all new weapons and active abilities so feel free to mod new cool characters.

We hope that you like and enjoy this update.

notes.title: Update with new content is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Blazing Beaks v1.1 is here! Thanks to our community for making suggestions and sending ideas. Some of the them made it to this update.
After reading all the feedback and ideas for this update we focused on adding more content and making the game accessible to more players. So here's a brief summary of what's new in this expansion.

17 new artifacts have been added in the game so get ready for even more hectic artifact combinations. Don't forget to bring those pesky artifacts to the Crow, because with this update it will additionally have 6 new items to offer.
One of the most anticipated things which our community voted for was new characters. So Blazing Beaks officialy increases beaks squad with 2 new characters in the game.
We are also introducing Challenges mode. 5 new challenges with some twists will require even more dexterous while you make your way through piles of enemies. 
Speaking of enemies the total monsters army in the game has been increased by adding 2 new enemies. One of them will test your skills at its hardest while another will make things a bit easier.
We spent a lot of time trying to make the game accessible to as many players as possible. Blazing Beaks has been localized into 5 additional languages - Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French and Spanish. That makes a total of 11 different languages in the game.

We hope that you like and enjoy this update. Don't hesitate to give us your feedback and suggestions.

DRM-free version update should come out shortly. Due to long approval processes update for Nintendo Switch should come out in January 2020.

[b]New[/b][list]
[*] Added 5 new languages: Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish.
[*] Added 6 new items.

[*] Added 2 new enemies.
[*] Added Challenges mode with 5 new challenges.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b][list]
[*] Proofread 3 languages: German, Brazilian-Portuguese, Turkish.
[*] Changed how Newts tongue can be stuck on the log. Now it's easier to do that.
[*] Players now can loop the game if auto-aim is set at 100%.
[*] Added alternative controls for firing weapon and using ability. Not only you can use the same LT/RT buttons for using ability/firing weapon, but now you can alternatively use LB/LR buttons for using ability/firing weapon.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where in some occasions Guts artifact didn't take away any HP when it had to do so.
[*] Fixed a bug when dead co-op player was visible in the next level if someone had Guts artifact in possession.

[*] Fixed a bug where Death artifact didn't work if player was hit with Newts tongue.
[*] Fixed a bug where having Bubble ability active returning Bogy bones would still deal damage to a player.
[/list]

To celebrate the release of new update we are making Blazing Beaks Daily Run contest on our Discord server where 10 players will win Blazing Beaks t-shirts. The contest starts on Dec 5th, 10AM PST and ends on Dec 8th, 10AM PST. 
You can find more information on Blazing Beaks Discord server: https://discord.gg/BlazingBeaks

notes.title: Update 29 (v1.0.1.0)
notes.content:
Hi,

We’ve got a lot of feedback after release. Some rare bugs were found and reported so we published few hotfix updates before this one, but haven’t posted any patch notes. We also updated Blazing Beaks Character Editor a couple of times.

We read all the feedback and issues addressed and this update already has a solutions to some of them. We adjusted RNG a bit, because there were a lot of concerns that drops are too random. Now artifact drops will be more consistent without any big amount of levels without artifact drops in a row.

Also there were a lot of notes saying that shop doors appear too randomly or that there is no shop at all in the area. We want to emphasize that at least one shop door is guaranteed in every area pre-loop. In other words, it’s is guaranteed that you will find at least one shop door if you go till the last level of the area, where the only choice to go from there is boss door. This rule remains unchanged.

We updated official Blazing Beaks Wiki page as well: [url=https://blazingbeaks.gamepedia.com/Blazing_Beaks_Wiki]https://blazingbeaks.gamepedia.com/Blazing_Beaks_Wiki[/url]

More patch notes about the update:

[b]New[/b][list]
[*] Added current weapons statistics in pause window.
[*] Added new “windowed” mode in video settings for display. It will upscale the game in windowed mode to the maximum to fit in the screen. This is useful for players who have high resolution monitors and want to play in windowed mode.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b][list]
[*] The type of run (Normal/Seeded/Daily) will be written in the end screen.
[*] Adjusted some weapons parameters representation.
[*] Proofread English texts.
[*] Added visual representation when weapon jams having Dirty Bubble Gum artifact.
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b][list]
[*] Artifact drops will be more consistent.
[*] Rebalanced loot drop from chests. Now chests in the locked levels will be more rewarding.
[*] Increased weapon damage for Nail Gun, Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher and Acid Gun.
[*] Balanced Newt boss. Now there will be more tongue attacks.
[*] Balanced the maximum stackable number for Blue Gem item.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game crashes when too small mod sprites textures are loaded.
[*] FIxed a bug with aiming where weapon was shooting not exactly through the center of crosshair.
[*] Stacked Shadow artifact was working as a single artifact even if multiple Shadow artifacts were stacked. Now Shadow artifact cannot be stacked.[/list]

At the moment you can check Daily Runs Leaderboard TOP 10 in Blazing Beaks website [url=https://blazingbeaks.com]https://blazingbeaks.com[/url]. In a few days we will introduce a lot more features for Blazing Beaks leaderboards which will be available in [url=https://blazingbeaks.com]blazingbeaks.com[/url].

And even more exciting news!!! We started working on Blazing Beaks big content update (expansion) :)
Stay tuned! 

Best regards,
Blazing Beaks Team

notes.title: Blazing Beaks v1.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31045998/d11a78c6d80fa84607f75d7dafb7f8ae3910dabd.gif[/img]

Hi everyone,

Quaaack! We are super excited and thrilled today - can’t believe that after almost 3 and half years of development of Blazing Beaks this is happening today. ːsteamhappyː No more days of looking at calendars and waiting - Blazing Beaks exits Early Access and v1.0 together with an awesome update is now available to everyone! 

First of all, we want to say a big THANK YOU to everyone who played the game, gave us cool ideas, suggestions, spread a word about the game and helped to make Blazing Beaks a better game. Knowing that you enjoy the game, seeing those incredible runs on the internet, funny reactions, personal records was a huge motivation to keep developing the game. Your support has been amazing and we always felt that you got our backs!

[h1]Gift for Early Access players[/h1]
As a thank you we gifted DLC of Blazing Beaks OST for all Early Access purchasers for free.

[h1]Update 28[/h1]
Blazing Beaks full release comes with an awesome Update 28. One and the most anticipated part in the Story mode was missing, but now we added it - the game has an ending.
We also updated Blazing Beaks Characters Editor and added all the weapons that are currently in the game to it. Editor is included in Blazing Beaks package and you can find in under Tools section in your Steam Library. As usually, you can also download it from our website: https://blazingbeaks.com/mods/
We plan to improve Blazing Beaks Editor and the whole modding system in the future based on some suggestions that we’ve got.

Also we updated https://blazingbeaks.com website and now it has daily run leaderboard. We will keep updating it so that it would have more functionality.

More detailed update patch notes:

[b]New[/b][list]
[*] Added new area.
[*] Added 4 new enemies.
[*] Added 1 new boss for new area.
[*] Added 4 new weapons.
[*] Added 27 hand-crafted levels.
[*] Added new music track for new area.
[*] Added new music track for final boss fight.
[*] Added new music track for credits part.
[*] Added Steam Achievements.
[*] Added Steam Trading Cards.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b][list]
[*] Changed some sounds to the new ones.
[*] Adjusted some existing sounds.
[*] Adjusted some existing locked levels.
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b][list]
[*] Balanced some weapon prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where “Reset save” didn’t reset some statistics.
[*] Fixed a bug where unlock screen wasn’t showed in Daily runs if you unlocked something.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes Shadow artefact was unlocked earlier, because of incorrectly counting obtained weapons.
[*] Fixed a bug where obtained weapons count was wrongly represented by default.
[/list]

[h1]28 updates later…[/h1]
During Early Access period, we made 28 updates. It’s funny to remember that the very first game version did not even have an inventory window, had very few items and artefacts and players still loved and enjoyed the game. We are really happy when we look back of what has been done throughout Early Access.
 
[b]Here’s what has been done in 28 updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Daily Runs feature - all players can compete with each other in newly generated run everyday;
[*] Added Seeded Runs feature - players can play the same generated run over and over again;
[*] Added game difficulty setting - Easy, Normal, Hard;
[*] Added aim assist feature;
[*] Added 70 new items and artefacts;
[*] Added 32 new weapons;
[*] Added 3 new characters.
[*] Added 3 new areas;
[*] Added 15 new enemies;
[*] Added 3 new bosses;
[*] Added 139 hand-crafted levels;
[*] Added 8 active abilities;
[*] Added achievements;
[*] Added trading cards;
[*] Balanced and optimized game a lot, improved gameplay and user experience;
[*] Added tutorial;
[*] Reworked all 5 initial characters;
[*] Added machines for trading resources;
[*] Added secret levels;
[*] Reworked how game handles frame rate. Now it supports dynamic frame rate.
[*] Added ability to steal a weapon from the shop;
[*] Added inventory window on pause screen;
[*] Added collectables, statistics and progress system to the game;
[*] Additionally added support for other X-Input controllers, PS4 and other regular ones.
[*] With the help of our community we added Russian, German, Turkish, Brazilian-Portuguese and Polish languages in the game.
[*] Added character mods support, Steam Workshop and made Blazing Beaks Character Editor to help with modding.
[*] Added an option to bind keyboard keys;
[/list]

[h1]Future plans[/h1]
It’s no doubt that we will support the game after full release. If any urgent fixes are needed we will try to push updates as soon as possible. On the other hand, we will focus on bigger content updates, but that means that they will come out not as quickly. We already have some plans for upcoming content. Feel free to suggest your ideas. We will try to prioritize the things that players want the most.


Thank you once again for all the support. We hope that Blazing Beaks game will remain quacking for a long years to come and will keep players happy. Enjoy playing it!

Best regards,
Blazing Beaks Team

notes.title: Update 27 (v0.9.0) Daily Runs
notes.content:
Hi,

The new Blazing Beaks update is live now! It took longer than expected to make this new update, it needed a lot of testing to make sure it works as expected. In addition to that, we’ve been working on full release version as well which also affected the timeframe of this update. 

A lot of things were happening behind the scenes at the same time. We had an opportunity to attend Game Developers Conference in San Francisco. Blazing Beaks was showcased in two events: The Mix and European Game Showcase. We met a lot of amazing people, got very valuable feedback and suggestions. This update introduces Daily Runs. Players now can compete with each other in newly generated run everyday. Each daily run can be played only once and most of unlockables cannot be unlocked in this mode. Daily run can be played in co-op mode too. 

Players get ranked by the total score they accumulate in the end of the run. And here's more detailed information on how the score is calculated:
[list]
[*] [b]10 POINTS[/b] for every opened chest;
[*] [b]30 POINTS[/b] for every deal in the shop (artefacts/items exchange, weapon purchase, reviving co-op player);
[*] For every picked up artefact, it’s [b]RISK VALUE IS MULTIPLIED BY 100[/b] and that’s the amount of points the player gets (for example: artefact risk value 0.3 means that player gets 30 points);
[*] Player gets the amount of points equal to killed [b]ENEMY OR BOSS STARTING HP[/b];
[*] And the most important thing is [b]MULTIPLIER[/b]. The more artefacts player has in possession, the higher multiplier is.
[/list]

We need more players to try daily runs to see a general view of how the system, points calculation is working and etc. So don’t hesitate to give us your feedback so that we could improve it in the future.

notes.title: Update 26 (v0.8.1)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are very glad to start 2019 with a new Blazing Beaks update. Now you can play not only normal runs as before but also seeded runs where players will be able to play exactly the same runs if the same seed number is entered. 
Although seeded runs guarantee the same levels layout, the same amount of enemies, the same type of enemies and even which enemies drop loop - sometimes the outcome of loot dropped will be different. This is because loot drop depends on various things and player actions - for example, if player decides not to pick up any artefact, decides exchange them into items or not and etc.
In seeded runs all items, artefacts can be dropped and all weapons can be used so most of unlockables cannot be unlocked in this mode.

Players now will be able to select game difficulty level of their choice. Normal difficulty is the one that you played by default up to this update. The game is intended to be played in Normal difficulty. Nevertheless, there are players to whom the game is too easy or too difficult. For them we made Easy and Hard difficulty levels. Easy - enemies have only half HP as in Normal difficulty. Hard - enemies are more aggressive and deal twice as more damage. We encourage players who play Easy or Hard difficulties to leave feedback in Steam community hub: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/585710/discussions/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/585710/discussions/[/url]

We also added Aim Assist feature. You can choose the amount of aim assist to help you aim to enemies. If it's set to 100%, then it will aim to the nearest possible enemy for you.

As we promised before, we added keyboard binding feature. Now in Options, Keyboard Layout you can set your preferred keys for playing the game.

[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1][list]

Additionally some various optimizations and small bug fixes were done too.

Best regards,
Blazing Beaks Team

notes.content:
Hi,

The main focus for this update was on performance. Until now the game was running at a fixed frame rate (60 fps). Due to game engine specifics, even if the players had high spec PC sometimes they experienced frame rate lower than 60 fps. For those and for the players who had lower spec hardware, the game was running slower. With this update the game now has a dynamic frame rate, so ones who have computers which can handle high frame rates now can enjoy even smoother gameplay, and those who see up to 60 fps can have full game experience.

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
[*] Adjusted colliders for Brute, Puffs and Fat Fly.
[*] Fixed Grenade Launcher spelling mistake.
[*] Fixed a spelling mistake in Frying Pan description.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Zip bullet hitting ghost statue triggered ghost to appear on wrong side.
[*] Fixed a bug where wrong number of items near risk value indication bar was showed when the risk value of last collected artefact was equal to the remaining risk value in the bar.
[*] Fixed a bug where risk value bar was visually filled a little bit even if you did not have any artefacts in possession.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes Jut’s lightning was visually in the wrong position for the first few frames.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t deal damage to enemies with Needle item if Cloak item was in effect.
[*] Fixed a bug where picking up an item in the shop would also caused accidentally buying or stealing a gun. Now you can do one action at a time.
[/list]

New area is in the making and after couple updates you can enjoy it.

Best regards,
Blazing Beaks Team

notes.title: Update 7 (v0.5.80)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31045998/412355dfcfd849be625500d12147c3b16117b3d5.png[/img]
Hi,

We would like to introduce Update 7. We did not manage to do everything what we planned so we will put these in upcoming updates. The biggest change in the game with this update is the changed artefacts/items exchange system. You can read more below, so here’s an overview of this update. 

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes you could deal damage to Creep when he’s hiding.
[*] Fixed a bug where a crosshair was visible after co-op player was dead, if he was playing with mouse and keyboard.
[*] Fixed a bug where first shot had a wrong direction if Fire button was held while a player was jumping out of the hatch.
[*] Fixed a bug where some weapons would not deal damage to enemies if they were standing very close to the wall above them.
[*] Fixed a bug where Fat Fly exploded running into the worm even if he was under the ground.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
[*] Changed Items/Artefacts exchange system. Now every artefact has it’s risk value depending on the negative impact it has. The number of items you get in the shop now depends on the total risk value you carried. The indicator at the top will show the minimum amount of items you will get in the shop and how much risk value you still need to collect for additional item. So with this new system players will be rewarded more. 
[*] Edited Lunch Box and Lock Pick Set descriptions.
[*] Added additional animation for Puffus when he’s dead but not exploded.
[*] Older versions had an option to turn on adjusted movement controls for gamepad with F8 keyboard key. Now it’s deprecated.
[*] Improved movement controls for gamepad.
[*] Improved shooting. Now the speed of bullet also depends on player’s movement.
[*] Improved aiming with gamepad.
[*] Changed the movement of the main Black Matter Gun bullet. Now it’s more predictable and has a range.
[*] Razor Gun now has a distance parameter instead of number of bounces.
[*] Adjusted player’s slide ability.
[*] Explosion marks now are shown below the spikes.
[*] Butterflies in Swamp are now more blended into the environment.
[*] Added additional pre-explode animation for Fat Fly. It will work as an indicator that Fat Fly is about to explode.
[*] If you want to give the artefacts to the crow, you no longer need to wait while the text over the crow disappears.
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1][list]
[*] Golden Bullet item now increases weapon damage by 0.5% for every coin you have. (Previously it was 0.2%).
[*] Pistol, Double pistol and Shotgun bullets are more accurate now. Previously it had a small deviation on every shot.
[*] Coupon item - increased the discount for weapons by 10%.
[*] Red Juice item - changed what it does. Now it refills your HP and if you already have full HP adds 1 max HP.
[*] Hourglass item - increased the chance to get HP every time you enter next level.
[*] Rusted coin item - increased the amount of coins you get after picking up the item from +1 to +5.
[*] Stethoscope item - increased a chance to loot more hearts.
[*] Keychain item - increased a chance to loot more keys.
[*] Cooked Plump-plant item - now it gives +2 max HP instead of +1.
[*] Metal detector item - tweaked a little bit.
[*] Jar with Stardust item - inverted what it does. Now it decreases explosion range.
[*] Pot item - adjusted the chance to loot more coins.
[*] Transdimentional Pizza - additionally it will increase weapon damage.
[*] Blank Check - the player who picks up this item now also gets 1 key. 
[*] Love - now it will add max HP instead of HP for co-op player.
[*] Sandwich - changed what it does. Now it adds your HP to your max HP but not more than 3.
[/list]

We plan to release a small update this Friday which will include some of community suggested items and artefacts.

Best regards,
Blazing Beaks team

notes.title: Update 4 (v0.5.77)
notes.content:
Hello,

Here's a small update.
As planned, first and second week after Early Access launch was dedicated to bug fixing, balancing the game and making small changes. As currently there aren't any major issues with the game, we will start adding more content with the next update. That does not mean that we will put bug fixing and balancing aside. We plan that the next update will come after one week - next Friday.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed the bug where razor gun sound was duplicating in Tournament mode.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
[*] Updated some sounds.
[*] Corrected the name of Cooked Plum-plant item.
[*] Changed descriptions of Magnet, Pot, Golden Heart items and Eye Mask artefact.
[*] Crosshair will be seen as soon as the level appears if you play with mouse.
[*] Changed what Lost Package item does.
[*] Bosses now push away hearts on contact.
[/list]

[h1]New[/h1][list]
[*] Now you can make a screenshot using F12 keyboard button. Now you can share screenshots with others.
[*] Added new option “Run and Aim” in controls window. If this option is OFF, movement using gamepad or keyboard with No Mouse mode ON will have no affect for aiming.
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1][list]
[*] Boss now drops at least 1 artefact after defeat.
[*] Creep HP increased by 2.
[*] The later you go to the boss, the bigger chance it will be stronger.
[*] Enemies won’t attack players for some time after entering the level.
[*] Increased a possibility for Idol item to give max HP instead of HP when player picks up a heart.
[*] Adjusted delay between boss attacks. Bosses didn’t become weaker or stronger but the fight itself became faster. Now you should spend less time in boss fights as you will spend less time waiting for attacks.
[/list]

Best regards,
Blazing Beaks Team

notes.title: Update 3 (v0.5.76)
notes.content:
Hello,

We took your feedback into consideration and made the changes to the game. More improvements will be in the future updates. If urgent fixes will not be needed we plan to have the next update this Friday.

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game view was not centred correctly if the display is not 16:9 (If someone has a display with super wide screen it would be great if you could confirm that game view is centred correctly).
[/list]
 
[h1]Balance:[/h1][list]
[*] Increased the time interval when acid deals damage to enemies.
[*] Adjusted Z index of Spawner egg. Now the egg should be seen when dead enemies cover them fully.
[*] Zits now can spawn only hearts during boss fight.
[*] Increased the number of enemies in Red Forest.
[*] Increased HP and attack range for Jut.
[*] Creep can now be damaged only if he’s not hiding.
[*] Bushes won’t drop loot anymore, instead enemies will drop loot a bit more often.
[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1][list]
[*] Now when bluebird takes damage he throws a bomb towards crosshair.
[*] At game over window it is shown that you died from Lost package if you did so.
[*] Because now bushes won’t drop any loot, Eye Mask artefact became ineffective. For that reason we changed what this artefact does and now it decreases weapon accuracy.
[/list]

[h1]New:[/h1][list]
[*] Now the mouse will be locked in the bounds of game display playing in full screen mode (it’s very useful for those who play with several displays).
[*] Crow in the shop will have an indication shown until you bring artefacts for the first time ever.
[/list]

Best regards,
Blazing Beaks Team
